verdict.rationale: Supabase lets you capture changes in schema migration files kept in version control (supabase-docs-25), and branching gives isolated preview environments per pull request for review (supabase-docs-26, supabase-docs-36). Cron jobs and webhooks live inside Postgres (supabase-docs-9, supabase-docs-8), so they could be versioned through migrations, but the evidence never says so. Rollback is only indirect via daily backups (supabase-docs-11). Community users call the migration workflow a weakness because the dashboard encourages direct production edits (supabase-comm-5, supabase-comm-6, supabase-comm-7). missing for 10: explicit versioning of automations (cron, webhooks, Edge Functions), a documented rollback or revert mechanism for automation changes, and independent hands-on corroboration of a review/rollback workflow.
